title: Mission & Payload Sandbox: Technical Requirements Specification

requirements.title: First-order performance outputs
requirements.text: The sandbox shall compute orbital period, ground speed, ground sampling distance, swath, revisit, signal-to-noise ratio, data volume and downlink capacity from declared input parameters.
requirements.rationale: Core function: a mission and payload trade-off needs these quantities together.

requirements.title: Agreement with published missions
requirements.text: With the Sentinel-2, Landsat 8/9 and HiRISE/MRO presets, the computed orbital period, inclination, ground sampling distance, swath and uncompressed data rate shall be within 5% of the published values, and the transmitter EIRP within 1 dB.
requirements.rationale: The model is only useful for trade-offs if it reproduces real missions.

requirements.title: Visible formulas and assumptions
requirements.text: Each displayed result shall be accompanied by its formula, its assumptions and its range of validity.
requirements.rationale: Transparency: the user must be able to judge every number.

requirements.title: Live requirement compliance matrix
requirements.text: A compliance matrix of user-defined requirements shall be updated at every change of input, showing value, margin in per cent and status.
requirements.rationale: Shows how a design change propagates to every requirement.

requirements.title: Budgets with ESA margins
requirements.text: Mass, power and data budgets shall apply the ESA margin policy: unit maturity margins of at least 5%, 10% or 20% (categories A/B, C, D) and a system margin of 20%.
requirements.rationale: Margin philosophy for science assessment studies, ESA (issue 1.3).

requirements.title: Celestial body switch
requirements.text: Switching the central body between Earth and Mars shall update gravitational parameter, radius, J2, solar irradiance and distance from Earth.
requirements.rationale: The same mission must be comparable around Earth and around Mars.

requirements.title: Responsiveness without a server
requirements.text: Every change of input shall be recomputed in the browser in less than 100 ms, without a server.
requirements.rationale: Smooth interaction and zero running cost.

requirements.title: Sharing and export
requirements.text: A configuration shall be shareable through a link and exportable as JSON and as a PDF summary, with the interface in English and Italian.

requirements.title: Payload families
requirements.text: The user shall select the payload family (phase 1: multispectral imager and imaging spectrometer) and adjust its parameters, or start from a real preset.
requirements.rationale: Designing an instrument, not only reading one.

requirements.title: Shared platform resources
requirements.text: With two payloads on the same platform, power, memory and downlink shall be shared budgets, and the share of each payload shall be shown.
requirements.rationale: Interfaces between subsystems are where design conflicts appear.
